content:
Kofi Kingston joins "Ghost Hunters" on Halloween

WWE Universe, don't miss Kofi Kingston as he joins the Ghost Hunters Halloween Live special on Syfy Sunday night! The SmackDown Superstar will join Jason Hawes, Grant Wilson and the rest of the TAPS team as they investigate and search for paranormal activity at the Buffalo Central Terminal live for six hours on the most haunted night of the year.

According to Syfy.com, the now-abandoned Buffalo Central Terminal in Buffalo, N.Y., is a place "where full-bodied apparitions roam the concourse, restless spirits hover on the third floor and female voices cry out for help in an elevator shaft near the baggage claim."

While watching Ghost Hunters Halloween Live, the WWE Universe is also invited to log on to Syfy.com to watch four live camera feeds from inside the historic train terminal, which was open from 1929 to 1979. You can also chat live with TAPS and Kingston throughout the event and inform the Ghost Hunters of any paranormal activity you witness by hitting the "panic button." Josh Gates of Syfy's Destination Truth will be host.

Kingston joins the likes of other WWE Superstars who have joined the Ghost Hunters Halloween Live investigations, including The Miz at Fort Delaware, the haunted Civil War POW Camp; and CM Punk at the Stanley Hotel, the spooky Colorado destination that inspired Stephen King's The Shining.

All of the haunted Ghost Hunters Halloween Live action begins Halloween night at 7/6 CT on Syfy!

Kara A. Medalis
